name: cx-goal-one-rule~p2
task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task's first sentence is 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — a preference ('try not to'). The key_lost proposition is defined as 'the matching key was acquired and then lost before the door was opened', which already contains the condition (lost while the door was closed). Per the clause language, when the event's description already holds the condition, the ban is a soft Absence(key_lost), not a Precedence/Response. The candidate instead contains a hard Response(door_open, has_door_key), which wrongly turns the preference into a hard requirement and encodes a key-before-door obligation the task never states ('do not drop' is about losing the key, not about holding it when opening). Replace it with a soft Absence(key_lost). Keep the hard Existence(door_open) and hard Existence(target_picked_up).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Try not to' makes Absence(key_lost) soft, correctly reading 'drop the key while the door is still closed' as key_lost since its definition already includes the closed-door condition. Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures 'Open the door, then pick up the box' and together force the door opening.

texts: Try not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
Open the door, then pick up the box.
The agent must pick up the target box.
